name: Neuron (Multipolar Motor Nerve Cell)
semanticDescription: Medical-grade anatomical 3D model of a multipolar motor neuron conforming to NCERT Class 10 (Ch 7, Fig 7.1) and Class 11 (Ch 21, Fig 21.1) diagrams. Features organic cyton (perikaryon) deformed toward dendritic roots, prominent spherical nucleus with dark nucleolus, Nissl's granules, branching dendritic arbor with spines, conical axon hillock, continuous central axon core, 5 segmented Schwann cell myelin sheaths with realistic rounded collars and constricted Nodes of Ranvier, outer Schwann cell nuclei, and terminal telodendria arborization with bulbous synaptic boutons. Features dual presentation collections (Neuron_Full and Neuron_Section).
simplifications: Dendritic arbor simplified to primary, secondary, and tertiary branches with spines for educational clarity.
Myelin sheath modeled as segmented cylindrical Schwann cells with distinct Nodes of Ranvier.
